output.population: Participants at the NeuroCognition Laboratory, San Diego, wearing 32 head and face electrodes
output.summary: EEG recorded during a picture-word interference naming experiment. Participants named line drawings preceded by semantically related, identical, or unrelated distractor words, with voice responses digitized and button presses advancing self-paced trials.
